author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಧರ್ಮವೊಂದಿಲ್ಲಿಹುದು ಮತಗಳಿವೆ ನೂರಾರು
ಕರ್ಮಸಾಧನೆಯೊಂದೆ ಎಲ್ಲದರ ಗುರಿಯು
ಮರ್ಮವಿದನರಿಯುತಿರೆ ಜೀವನದಿ ಸುಖವುಂಟು
ನರ್ಮದಲೆ ನಡೆಯುತಿರು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: There is one dharma here; there are hundreds of creeds;
the one aim of them all is the fulfilment of right action;
if you understand this secret, life holds happiness;
walk on with gentle humour, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Many creeds, one dharma: all point to doing what is right. Grasp this and life becomes lighter and happier.
